story_title: Seven bedrooms, one view, the whole group under one roof.
story_lead: Double-height living facing the fields, a private spa and a lap pool at the edge of the rice paddies. Warm oak, polished concrete and black steel, set against an open, unobstructed view. Umalas is a quiet village on the edge of Seminyak and Canggu: village setting, city access.
story_points: 7 en-suite bedrooms, each with a king bed, for up to 14 guests
Lap pool on the rice fields, private spa, sauna and gym
A dedicated butler for the whole stay: fresh breakfasts and in-villa meals cooked to order
Seminyak 5 min, Berawa Beach and Finns 10 min, the airport 30 to 45 min
book_lead: Included: a dedicated private butler, daily housekeeping, fresh linen and towels, pool and garden care, drinking water and fast Wi-Fi. Meals are cooked by your butler, ingredients at cost. On request: airport transfer, in-villa massage, private chef evenings, car and scooter rental, day tours.
amenities: Lap pool on the rice fields
